raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #38815. In a joint Full/SWA/Mamba cache, `cache_finished_req` (and the unfinished twin) truncates the insert key to the smallest component boundary (`effective_cache_len = min(...)` across component prepare hooks). An SWA branch at 96 leaves the insert leaf at 96, while `MambaComponent.prepare_for_caching_req` has already attached the Mamba state tracked at 192 to the insert params. Both commit implementations then stamped state192 onto key96, and the reporter's H200 repro shows the consequence: a warm-cache request hitting 96 resumes from the wrong state, with diverged logprobs in all three input groups.

## Changes

The Mamba value now carries the seqlen it was produced at through `InsertParams` — Python side, the Rust binding, and the Rust in-flight `InsertWalkState` — and both commit sites skip the stamp when the inserted key's token length doesn't match it (atom length plus the bigram overlap for EAGLE keys):

- `python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/unified_cache/components/mamba_component.py`: `commit_insert_component_data` returns early on misalignment; `cleanup_after_caching_req` treats a skipped value as not-inserted on both the finished and unfinished paths (int8 slot freed, ping-pong slot not kept).
- `rust/sglang-radix-tree/src/components/mamba.rs`: same guard in the Rust component, so the Rust TreeCore deployment the reporter reproduced on is covered.
- `python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/rust_tree_core/adapter.py` and `rust/sglang-radix-tree/src/python_bindings.rs`: `mamba_value_seqlen` threaded through the binding (defaulted `None`, so non-tracked inserts keep legacy behavior).

A truncated finish therefore simply doesn't checkpoint that state instead of caching a wrong one. This is strictly safer: the resume falls back to recomputation on the existing no-checkpoint path instead of resuming from a later state.

## Test plan

- New Rust unit test `misaligned_mamba_value_is_not_stamped` in `src/tests/components/mamba.rs`: key96 + seqlen192 leaves zero Mamba values in the tree; the same leaf then accepts the value once seqlen matches its position.
- New Python unit test `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_mamba_value_alignment.py` (registered `base-a-test-cpu`): misaligned not stamped, aligned stamped, untracked value keeps legacy behavior.
- Verified locally on this Mac: full Rust suite `cargo test -p sglang-radix-tree` **847 passed / 0 failed** (torch 2.11 build venv, CPU); Python component tests 3/3; existing Python Mamba suites `test_mamba_path_state_cap` + `test_mamba_donated_alloc_ratio` 16 passed with no regressions.
- Not run locally (no GPU): the KL-level suites (`test_unified_radix_cache_kl_mamba`, `_kl_swa`, `_kl_hybrid_bitexact`) — those exercise this path on real models and are the right CI coverage for it.

AI disclosure: this change was prepared with AI assistance (Kimi); the mechanism trace, both fixes, and every verification command above were run as stated.

nodes.body:
Rebased onto current main (76e06feba). The unified cache area moved a lot since this branch (session_id threading, FULL pin helpers, read-only FULL prefix match), and 11 of 12 files overlapped, so a few notes on how the replay was checked:

- Only one textual conflict: the InsertParamsBinding pyo3 signature. Resolved as the union (`session_id = None` and `mamba_value_seqlen = None` both kept, order matches the fn parameters).
- Hunk audit of the replay against the pre-rebase diff: identical +/- counts on all 12 files, nothing silently dropped. Upstream's additions don't intersect the stamp path.
- `cargo test` in `rust/sglang-radix-tree`: 868 passed, 0 failed (includes the alignment cases).
- The Python regression test turned out to have been written against wrong module paths (`components.mamba_component` / `components.tree_component`) and had never actually run; fixed the imports in the third commit and it now executes for real. 3 passed on this branch. Against pre-fix main the untracked 96-key insert gets stamped with the 192-state (the bug from #38815 reproduces), while the tracked misaligned insert is now skipped and the aligned one still stamps.

Still needs the run-ci label from a maintainer for the full suite.

Second ping, four weeks after the first. Re-verified on current main (93809202a3): the joint Full/SWA/Mamba insert still truncates the key to the minimum component boundary while `MambaComponent.prepare_for_caching_req` attaches the state tracked at the longer `mamba_last_track_seqlen`, so the tree can hold a Mamba checkpoint addressed by a key shorter than the sequence it describes (#38815). The fix spans the Python components and the Rust tree adapter. Could a maintainer add the run-ci label and take a look?

+"""CPU-only regression for the misaligned Mamba checkpoint attach (#38815).
+
+A shared insert truncates the key to the smallest component boundary (e.g.
+the SWA branch), while the Mamba value was produced at its own later track
+seqlen. Stamping that value on the shorter leaf attaches a later state to an
+earlier key. The component now skips the stamp, and cleanup treats the value
+as not-inserted.
+"""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.base_prefix_cache import InsertParams, InsertResult
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.radix_cache import RadixKey
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.component_type import ComponentType
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.components.mamba import (
+    MambaComponent,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.unified_tree_core import (
+    UnifiedLRUList,
+    UnifiedTreeNode,
+)
+
+
+class _FakeTreeCore:
+    tree_components = (ComponentType.FULL, ComponentType.MAMBA)
+    is_eagle = False
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.root_node = UnifiedTreeNode(self.tree_components)
+        self.component_evictable_size_ = {ComponentType.MAMBA: 0}
+        self.lru_lists = {
+            ComponentType.MAMBA: UnifiedLRUList(
+                ComponentType.MAMBA, self.tree_components
+            )
+        }
+
+
+def _component():
+    core = _FakeTreeCore()
+    component = object.__new__(MambaComponent)
+    component.tree_core = core
+    component.mamba_max_states_per_path = 1000  # no cap eviction in these tests
+    return component, core
+
+
+class TestMambaValueAlignment(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _params(self, key_len, seqlen):
+        params = InsertParams(
+            key=RadixKey(list(range(key_len))),
+            mamba_value=torch.tensor([7]),
+            mamba_value_seqlen=seqlen,
+        )
+        return params
+
+    def test_misaligned_value_is_not_stamped(self):
+        component, core = _component()
+        node = UnifiedTreeNode(core.tree_components)
+        result = InsertResult(prefix_len=0)
+
+        component.commit_insert_component_data(
+            node, True, self._params(key_len=96, seqlen=192), result, []
+        )
+
+        assert node.component_data[ComponentType.MAMBA].value is None
+        assert core.component_evictable_size_[ComponentType.MAMBA] == 0
+
+    def test_aligned_value_is_stamped(self):
+        component, core = _component()
+        node = UnifiedTreeNode(core.tree_components)
+        result = InsertResult(prefix_len=0)
+
+        component.commit_insert_component_data(
+            node, True, self._params(key_len=192, seqlen=192), result, []
+        )
+
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            node.component_data[ComponentType.MAMBA].value, torch.tensor([7])
+        )
+        assert core.component_evictable_size_[ComponentType.MAMBA] == 1
+
+    def test_untracked_value_keeps_legacy_behavior(self):
+        # No seqlen recorded (non-tracked inserts): no alignment check fires.
+        component, core = _component()
+        node = UnifiedTreeNode(core.tree_components)
+        result = InsertResult(prefix_len=0)
+        params = InsertParams(
+            key=RadixKey(list(range(96))), mamba_value=torch.tensor([7])
+        )
+
+        component.commit_insert_component_data(node, True, params, result, [])
+
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            node.component_data[ComponentType.MAMBA].value, torch.tensor([7])
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
